title: ロボットインテリジェンス
subtitle: Robot Intelligence
educationalGoal: Learn the basics of machine learning, which is one of many subfields of artificial intelligence and is applied in various fields including robotics, where it can play an important role especially for treating uncertainty that a robot can encounter in the real world, in order to be able to apply it in developing a robot.
advice: This is a basic course in machine learning, which is one of the many artificial intelligence subfields and is applied in various fields, including robotics, where it can play an important role. We will mainly cover the following chapters of the textbook: Chapter 1, Introduction Chapter 2, Probability Distributions Chapter 3, Linear Models for Regression Chapter 4, Linear Models for Classification Students are expected to actively participate in class. Students are expected to complete exercises independently. Students are required to be aware of the instructor's messages in the class and to check for messages/materials on the KIT Inside website before every class because the course schedule may change depending on the class progress.
books: Textbook: Christopher M. Bishop, Pattern Recognition and Machine Learning, First Volume, Maruzen Publishing Co., Ltd., 2012 (in Japanese).
requiredKnowledge: Sufficient knowledge in mathematics (especially regarding differential and integral calculus and linear algebra) Completion of Integrated Math and Science for Engineering I & II, and Linear Algebra I & II.
